infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: NayanSaathi requires rear camera access to scan and identify Indian currency notes offline.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NayanSaathi uses microphone access for on-device voice commands to control scanning, check wallet totals, and split cash.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: NayanSaathi uses on-device speech recognition to process accessibility voice commands completely offline.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow NayanSaathi to access the camera to identify currency notes offline.
